name: 食事の受渡し方法と場所の案内を伝える
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE Japanese Lighthouse handoff instruction form LH19-0016 on pure-white canvas, compact complete portrait.
Input1 ORIGINAL Grab source highest authority for fine input/control anatomy, selected/unselected tabs, plus-image outline icon geometry, proportions, optical stroke/alignment/spacing. Input2 Japanese mock SECONDARY copy/layout; its camera glyph is a rough substitute. Restore ORIGINAL outline landscape/image-with-plus glyph for photo-add, NOT camera. Input3 approved Lighthouse style only: rounded white card/input surfaces, fine neutral borders, soft restrained elevation, forest-green gradient selected controls/primary action.
Exact content/order: label「部屋・階の番号」; white input with「02-02」. Bold section「受渡しの案内」. Body「すばやく届けるための案内を追加できます。」. Two equal choices: SELECTED「置き配」 with forest-green gradient and white label; UNSELECTED「手渡し」 white with neutral outline. White rounded textarea, text「玄関に置いてください。」at top-left; small gray「11 / 255」 bottom-right (Japanese text has11characters, preserve this counter). Below a modest dashed-outline square photo-add control with source image-plus icon in slate and label「写真を追加」. Bottom full-width forest-gradient primary「確認する」.
Primary/selected gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, clear white labels, subtle edge light. Supporting glyphs #526173. Main ink#1D1D1D, secondary#6E6E6E. Locked Meiryo headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0, preserve compact Japanese wrapping. All fields/actions visible without clipping or excessive blank height; textarea remains usable, photo placeholder modest. No source address/map/payments/app-specific privacy text outside reusable target; no extra content, random icon color, broad mint, excessive gloss or watermark.
reviewNotes: 原本・日本語モック・編集状態を実見。02-02、置き配選択／手渡し未選択、案内文と11/255、写真追加、確認を確認。原本優先でcamera代替をimage-plus glyphへ戻し、森林色の選択と主要操作、スレート補助アイコン、白面と欠けなしを確認。厳密フォント寸法・入力連動・写真追加や送信の実動作・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
